svg.title: Longshore drift, groynes and sea defences
svg.desc: A bird's-eye view of a beach: waves driven by the prevailing wind approach at an angle, the swash carries sand up the beach at an angle and the backwash pulls it straight back, so longshore drift moves it along the coast; groynes trap sand on their updrift side, a sea wall and rock armour protect the coast, and drift builds a spit across a bay. An inset shows the sea wall and rock armour from the side.

g.text: Up the beach at an angle
